rule: Canonical definitions and reviewed source bindings are recorded separately. Source code presence does not prove deployed collection, consent, durable storage or Growth aggregates. Missing denominators and unavailable data must never be replaced with zero or inferred conversion.

sourceBindings.availability: Helper and CTA hooks present in source; deployed collection and Growth aggregate unverified

sourceBindings.name: data-analytics-event=waitlist_cta_click
sourceBindings.persistence: CTA instrumentation attribute consumed by the public analytics layer
sourceBindings.availability: Header hooks present; not a verified unique-view or conversion denominator

events.purpose: two distinct value days in seven days

measurementAvailability: Activation, retention, attribution and meaningful value-day aggregates are unavailable for campaign optimization.
The protected waitlist RPC reports unique-contact status counts, not page views, submission attempts or eligibility after all suppression/delay/frequency rules.
Engagement lacks live provider events. Missing/zero denominators are unavailable; measured zero over a valid denominator can be 0%.
The bounded local event cache cannot establish a complete seven-day retention baseline.
